* A listener interface that enables customization of parse error handling.
 * An class that implements this interface is registered with the
 * parser and is called back from the parser handle parse errors.
 *
 * @version 1.2 $Revision: 1.7 $ $Date: 2009/07/17 18:58:01 $

methods.name: public void handleException(ParseException ex, SIPMessage sipMessage, Class headerClass, String headerText, String messageText) throws ParseException
methods.comment:
* This gets called from the parser when a parse error is generated. * The handler is supposed to introspect on the error class and * header name to handle the error appropriately. The error can * be handled by : *
    *
  • 1. Re-throwing an exception and aborting the parse. *
  • 2. Ignoring the header (attach the unparseable header to * the SIPMessage being parsed). *
  • 3. Re-Parsing the bad header and adding it to the sipMessage *
* * @param ex - parse exception being processed. * @param sipMessage -- sip message being processed. * @param headerText -- header/RL/SL text being parsed. * @param messageText -- message where this header was detected.

methodNames: public void handleException(ParseException ex, SIPMessage sipMessage, Class headerClass, String headerText, String messageText) throws ParseException
